title: マイルCSの後に・アツアツ激突！

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff… Huff!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Pheeew! I'm so full!

text_block_list.name: Bono Fan A
text_block_list.text: I can't believe how powerful Bono is! Did you see her round the fourth turn?!

text_block_list.name: Bono Fan A
text_block_list.text: Every one of her steps rang out like thunder! I couldn't help but yell and cheer just watching her!

text_block_list.name: Bono Fan B
text_block_list.text: Biko was great too. How she fits enough power to contend with Hishi Akebono into that small frame is beyond me. I couldn't take my eyes off them!

text_block_list.name: Bono Fan B
text_block_list.text: The way she kept her eyes on the prize and went full tilt… Man, that kind of performance just grabs your heart and doesn't let go!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I did it… I did iiit!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Thanks! Omigosh, did you see, though?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Biko was hotter than ever today! She was like a hard-boiled egg, right out of the pot!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I had sooo much fun racing against her!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Akebono looks even more excited than a kid in a candy store. Just then…

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Bono!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Biko!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I… I remembered! While I was running, I remembered what you told me!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Do you remember? You said that I'm a hero to you! When I thought of what you said, I felt a bunch of power surge up in me!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Thanks to that, I was able to unleash my full might and ran at my very best! Other people are saying I did really well too!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Bono, I have a request!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biko Pegasus squares her shoulders and takes in a deep breath.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I want to race you again on a massive stage! Please run against me again in March at the Takamatsunomiya Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I'll run even harder there than I did today! I promise to give you a race to remember!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh, Biko!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: So will you face me? Please!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: It'll be super-duper awesome to run in a race that'll make me even more full than today!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Right, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Right! Looks like our next race is set.
Right! Looks like our next race is set.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yaaay!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Now I have to do my best!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh, right! I almost forgot about the big lunch I packed today!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: We're eating it for dinner tonight, so why don't you join us? ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Next up will be the Takamatsunomiya Kinen. We'll be doing nothing but running in order to pursue even more excitement and fuller tummies!
